about.seo_desc: NajmaH is an AI-powered children's storytelling platform born from Dr. Elham Al-Rajhi's creative storytelling course.
about.hero_desc: NajmaH is an AI-powered platform that helps families and creators design magical, personalized children's stories. Every feature you see here was inspired by a real creative course — built to put world-class storytelling tools in everyone's hands.
about.origin_title: From a Course to a Platform
about.origin_desc: NajmaH was born from a creative storytelling course designed by Dr. Elham AlRajehy. What began as a curriculum to teach the art of children's literature evolved into a full interactive platform — combining proven storytelling principles with modern AI to bring imagination to life. Everything you experience here, from story building to visual design and AI illustration, mirrors the pillars of that course.

features.title: Story Building
features.desc: Craft compelling narratives that spark imagination and nurture children's values.

features.title: Visual Design
features.desc: Create unforgettable characters, immersive worlds, and richly illustrated pages.

features.title: AI-Powered Creativity
features.desc: Leverage modern AI tools to generate ideas, design illustrations, and accelerate production.

features.title: Publishing & Marketing
features.desc: Learn practical steps to publish your stories and reach the right audience worldwide.

about.instructor_bio: An interior architect, doctoral researcher in serious games and heritage, freelance children's book author, and developer of interactive applications. Dr. Elham combines deep academic expertise with a passion for education — empowering creators everywhere to unleash their imagination through storytelling.
about.curriculum_desc: Four progressive levels guiding you from your first story idea to a published, polished children's book.
about.testimonials_desc: Real stories from families, teachers and creators using NajmaH.

about.faq_desc: Everything you need to know before starting your creative journey.

faqs.q: Do I need any prior writing experience?
faqs.a: Not at all. NajmaH and the underlying course are designed for absolute beginners as well as experienced authors. Start where you are.
Yes — you can generate a free story right from the home page. Paid plans unlock unlimited stories, premium illustrations, narration and PDF export.

faqs.q: What ages are the stories designed for?
faqs.a: Stories are tuned to age bands from 3 to 12, following Piaget's developmental stages and trauma-informed safety rules.

faqs.q: Can I publish or print the stories I create?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Every story can be exported as a print-ready PDF. The course also walks you through self-publishing and marketing.
Arabic and English are fully supported, with more languages rolling out as the platform grows.
